source: SME Corp Malaysia, Guideline on SME Definition (March 2024)
rule: A business is classified by sales turnover OR full-time employees, whichever is LOWER. Must be registered with SSM (or equivalent) and not a subsidiary of a public-listed company, MNC or GLC.

services_and_other.note: Includes F&B, retail, distributive trade, hotels and restaurants, professional/ICT services, agriculture, construction

algorithm: sector_group = 'manufacturing' if sector is Manufacturing else 'services_and_other'
category_by_sales = first of micro/small/medium whose sales limit the turnover satisfies
category_by_employees = first of micro/small/medium whose employee limit the headcount satisfies
category = the SMALLER of the two (micro < small < medium)
if turnover and employees both exceed medium limits -> not an SME

group_rule.source: SME Corp Malaysia, Guideline on SME Definition (March 2024), section II(C) and FAQ 12
group_rule.rule: Size alone is not enough for SME assistance: the business must not be listed on a main board or be a subsidiary of a main-board company, large firm, MNC, GLC, MKD or state-owned enterprise. A subsidiary is an SME only if both parent and subsidiary meet the definition.
group_rule.independent_legal_forms_note: Matched as a case-insensitive prefix of profileExtras.legalForm. Sole proprietorships and partnerships (Registration of Businesses Act 1956) have no shareholders, so they are independent by construction. A limited liability partnership is a body corporate and is not on this list.
group_rule.when_unknown: A company (Sdn Bhd, Berhad, LLP) or an unknown legal form with no groupOwnership answer: assistance eligibility is cannot_determine. Ask the owner; never assume independent.

en.question: Is the business independent, or part of a group (a parent, holding or related company)?

ms.question: Adakah perniagaan ini bebas, atau sebahagian daripada kumpulan (syarikat induk, pegangan atau berkaitan)?

einvoice.authority: LHDN (Inland Revenue Board of Malaysia), MyInvois
einvoice.test: Annual turnover or revenue below the threshold: exempt from e-invoicing today. At or above it: required. Use the higher of the declared figure and the 12 months of sales in the data.
einvoice.group_exception: Not exempt when a non-individual shareholder, holding company or related company has revenue at or above RM3m (Guideline v4.8, per a secondary source: https://www.3ecpa.com.my/resources/corporate-compliance-requirement/malaysia-e-invoice/). A company with unknown group ties is cannot_determine, never exempt.
einvoice.next_check_reason: The penalty-free relaxation runs to 31 Dec 2027 (VERIFY against the official text); re-check after every LHDN guideline update and with each year's revenue.
einvoice.wording: Exempt means exempt today under this guideline version. Never say the business is compliant.
